lifecycleNodes.title: Product intent and problem discovery
lifecycleNodes.targetIntent: Bound Product intent, problem evidence, affected users, outcomes, and success hypotheses.

lifecycleNodes.title: Source-first workspace initialization and change governance
lifecycleNodes.targetIntent: Support optional source setup, Intake, Baseline, Provenance, explicit change review, and visible missing evidence.

lifecycleNodes.title: Product and Initiative definition
lifecycleNodes.targetIntent: Define the durable Product boundary and a bounded Initiative/context.

lifecycleNodes.title: Initiative classification and applicability
lifecycleNodes.targetIntent: Record classification, applicability, accountable decisions, and unresolved subjects.

lifecycleNodes.title: Product discovery
lifecycleNodes.targetIntent: Develop evidence-bound business understanding, stakeholder, outcome, and discovery records.

lifecycleNodes.title: Business architecture and value streams
lifecycleNodes.targetIntent: Model capabilities, value streams, operating context, and business rules without assuming an ERP Product.

lifecycleNodes.title: Domain discovery and Event Storming
lifecycleNodes.targetIntent: Capture domain events and collaborative domain discovery evidence.

lifecycleNodes.title: DDD strategic design and context mapping
lifecycleNodes.targetIntent: Define bounded contexts, relationships, ownership, and context maps.

lifecycleNodes.title: Solution, data, integration, security, privacy, and deployment architecture
lifecycleNodes.targetIntent: Bind solution, data, API/event/integration, security, privacy, quality, and deployment concerns.

lifecycleNodes.title: Architecture decisions and quality scenarios
lifecycleNodes.targetIntent: Record decisions, alternatives, constraints, quality scenarios, assurance needs, and review triggers.

lifecycleNodes.title: Phase, wave, Product, and vertical-slice planning
lifecycleNodes.targetIntent: Plan phases, waves, Products, dependencies, and demonstrable vertical slices.

lifecycleNodes.title: Product Design preparation and iterative evidence
lifecycleNodes.targetIntent: Prepare tool-neutral Product Design work, ingest iterative evidence, and support replaceable adapters such as optional Figma.

lifecycleNodes.title: Architecture-bound backlog, readiness, done, and test design
lifecycleNodes.targetIntent: Generate Epics, Features, User Stories, acceptance criteria, dependencies, Definition of Ready, Definition of Done, test cases, assurance, and traceability.

lifecycleNodes.title: Repository and implementation-target topology
lifecycleNodes.targetIntent: Define monorepo or polyrepo topology and backend, frontend, web, mobile, PWA, dashboard, admin, API, event, worker, and integration targets.

lifecycleNodes.title: Cross-repository slice distribution, synchronization, and drift
lifecycleNodes.targetIntent: Map each backlog slice to implementation targets and repositories, synchronize governed references, and detect drift.

lifecycleNodes.title: Governed implementation agents and code generation
lifecycleNodes.targetIntent: Run bounded implementation agents, code generation, source scanning, and evidence capture under explicit authority.

lifecycleNodes.title: Product QA and Product Owner acceptance
lifecycleNodes.targetIntent: Bind test evidence, Product QA, traceability, and a separate Product Owner acceptance decision.

lifecycleNodes.title: CI/CD, release, deployment, and environment governance
lifecycleNodes.targetIntent: Govern pipelines, releases, deployments, environment evidence, and explicit production authority boundaries.

lifecycleNodes.title: Operations, observability, incident/recovery evidence, and feedback
lifecycleNodes.targetIntent: Capture runtime observations, incidents, recovery evidence, and feedback into Product governance.

productOwnerRequirements.title: Source-first optional onboarding
productOwnerRequirements.gapOrDecision: No-source onboarding is supported; complete source-change UX remains a target gap.

productOwnerRequirements.title: Source Intake, Baseline, Provenance, and change governance
productOwnerRequirements.gapOrDecision: Explicit removal, exclusion, and supersession runtime workflows are not implemented.

productOwnerRequirements.title: Product discovery through DDD and context mapping
productOwnerRequirements.gapOrDecision: Target nodes are modeled; runtime split is planned.

productOwnerRequirements.title: Architecture before Product Design and backlog
productOwnerRequirements.gapOrDecision: Legacy runtime naming remains until a separately authorized migration.

productOwnerRequirements.title: Architecture-bound backlog, readiness, done, tests, and traceability
productOwnerRequirements.gapOrDecision: Target mappings exist; end-to-end runtime orchestration remains later work.

productOwnerRequirements.title: Repository topology and multiple implementation targets
productOwnerRequirements.gapOrDecision: Detailed target-form taxonomy needs a future P02 canonical correction.

productOwnerRequirements.title: Governed implementation, source scanning, and evidence
productOwnerRequirements.gapOrDecision: Future implementation prompts must preserve agent and human authority boundaries.

productOwnerRequirements.title: CI/CD, release, deployment, environments, and operations feedback
productOwnerRequirements.gapOrDecision: No current runtime checkpoint implements the complete target behavior.

productOwnerRequirements.title: ERP is illustrative, never a universal Product assumption
productOwnerRequirements.gapOrDecision: All generated target wording must remain Product-neutral.

productOwnerRequirements.title: Figma remains an optional Product Design adapter
productOwnerRequirements.gapOrDecision: Runtime compatibility wording remains; canonical target wording is Product Design.

productOwnerRequirements.title: Initiative classification, applicability, and unresolved decision governance
productOwnerRequirements.gapOrDecision: Current runtime behavior remains awaiting Product Owner acceptance.

proposedCanonicalGaps.title: Implementation-target form taxonomy
proposedCanonicalGaps.requiredCanonicalCorrection: GAEP-REG-013 capability taxonomy or a Product Owner-approved successor must explicitly model web, mobile, PWA, dashboard, admin, API, event, worker, integration, and multi-project topology breadth.

proposedCanonicalGaps.title: Source removal, exclusion, supersession, and temporary-unavailability workflow
proposedCanonicalGaps.requiredCanonicalCorrection: A future accepted Source-governance contract and runtime prompt must define human-scoped transitions, preserved revisions, and revalidation effects.

statePolicy.unknownRule: Unknown means not assessed or not established; it never means No.
statePolicy.colorRule: Every state uses text and an accessible marker; color is supplementary only.
